Remove ALL the paper background, all lettering and wordmark dashes, and remove ONLY the floating square brain cartridge above its head. Preserve the open top socket on the head; it will receive a separately rendered cartridge. Keep the complete body and tentacles visible, including thin data ribbons if they fit. There must be no solid background, paper tone, checkerboard pixels, shadow on a floor, rectangular plate or invented UI. Do not change its pose, materials, facial design or palette. This is an isolated cutout of the existing illustration, not a new mascot design.
